cohort: 429 pregnant women at KLES Dr Prabhakar Kore Hospital and Medical Research Centre, Belgaum, India, from January 2011 to March 2011.
finding: Nuchal cord was not associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, except for a lower Apgar score at 1 minute.
mod_finding: Though instrumental deliveries were more frequent in babies with nuchal cord, it was not statistically significant.
